description: Links one of your recipes to a firing log it went through, as the recipe page does, and sets what came of it there: the result in the person's words (at most 500 characters), and the cone and atmosphere when they differ from the log. Linked already, it changes only what is given. A recipe links to at most 100 logs. Taking a link off is done on the website. Save only what the person said and agreed to; never fill in an amount, temperature or analysis they did not give. Needs an access token that can read and change your records.

atmosphere.description: oxidation, reduction or neutral, when the person says it.

cone.description: The cone it was fired to there, as the recipe page writes it ("6", "06", "5.5", SK "6a", or "1240" for °C), when it differs from what the log says.

firingId.description: The firing log it went through, from list_firings.

result.description: What came of it in that firing, in the person’s words (at most 500 characters; put longer text in a notebook entry about the recipe).

name: link_firing
title: Save a test result for a recipe in a firing
